_comment: V2 feed — nested structure with a repeated key name. The vendor wrapped the export in an outer 'trial' block, and then used 'trial' again for the inner study-data block. The key 'trial' now appears at two different levels with different meanings. A procedural script using data['trial']['cohorts'] would break here; the V2 adapter absorbs this chaos so processors see the same TrialRecord as always.
